explanation: The theorem is a concrete numeric identity: t^(-5/2) * (√(3t))^5 = 3^(5/2) for t > 0. Mathlib contains only the general ingredients used in the proof (`Real.rpow_div_two_eq_sqrt`, `Real.mul_rpow`, `Real.rpow_neg`, `Real.rpow_natCast`, `Real.rpow_pos_of_pos`) but no declaration with this specific statement; grepping for the constants `5 / 2`, `3 * t` combined with `sqrt`/`rpow` in `Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Pow/Real.lean` and elsewhere turned up nothing. Deriving the statement from those general lemmas requires combining several of them (sqrt-to-rpow rewriting, multiplicativity of rpow, cancellation of exponents), well beyond one or two glue lines, so it is not a special case of any single Mathlib declaration either.
